missed.description: Wrong sentences the learner did not tap

Illustration.description:
A picture for a story scene. `prompt` describes it for the image model (authoring);
`image_path` (Cloud Storage) is filled in by the content tools, never written by hand.
Illustration.title: Illustration

LiveCheckAnswer.description: Indexes of the sentences of the session's answer that the learner thinks are wrong.
LiveCheckAnswer.title: LiveCheckAnswer

LiveCheckBlocked.description:
The prompt was not sent to the model (personal info, inappropriate, off the theme).
Nothing was recorded; the learner edits the prompt and tries again.
LiveCheckBlocked.title: LiveCheckBlocked

sources.description: Google Search sources of the correct answer
sources.title: Sources

ProgressSnapshot.description: Learner progress right after an action, returned so the app can update without a re-read.
ProgressSnapshot.title: ProgressSnapshot

PromptBlocked.description:
The prompt was not sent to the model, e.g. because it contains personal information.

This is an expected outcome (a teaching moment), not an error.
PromptBlocked.title: PromptBlocked

Scene.description:
One panel of a story: who speaks, what they say, and optionally a picture.
`audio_path` is filled in by the content tools (each speaker has its own voice).
Scene.title: Scene

outcome.description: What happens after the learner's choice
outcome.title: Outcome

WebSource.description: A web page Google Search returned for the grounded answer.
WebSource.title: WebSource
